title: Invoicing & payments View OFF with See Financial Data ON: prices show but invoices are not reachable
custom_preconds:
1. See Financial Data ON.
  2. A user has a role with Invoicing & payments View, Create & Edit and Delete all OFF.
custom_steps:
1. Open a work order.
  2. Look at the pricing columns.
  3. Look for the Finance tab.
custom_expected:
Pricing (totals, parts, labor cost) is shown.

The Finance tab is hidden and invoices cannot be reached.
